test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Shivani drives 17 km to the North, then drives 9 km East, and then drives 17 km South. How far is Shivani from the starting point when considered in a straight line?
solution:
Given:

Shivani drives 17 km to the North

Then drives 9 km East

And then drives 17 km South.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cd53f19db56fba94f6cf37731a745596b9623a47dae44813774ec5cc811869f7.png] 

Thus, Shivani is 9 km away from the starting point when considered in a straight line.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
